title: Brush Up: The 5-Minute Daily News - AI/Tech, Biz, World
description: Your definitive morning intelligence download. Every day shortly after 7:00 AM EST, we bypass the noise to deliver the critical shifts in AI, Global Business, and Macroeconomics that define the modern landscape. Brush up on the news while you brush up your smile.
latestSummary:
Apple is set to unveil major AI advancements at its June Worldwide Developers Conference, fueled by significant investment in the sector. Air Street Capital raised $232 million to back AI companies, and Gimlet Labs secured $80 million for its AI inference technology, promising improved processing efficiency across various chip manufacturers. Simultaneously, Littlebird raised $11 million for an AI-powered “recall” tool.

Cybersecurity remains a critical concern with the emergence of a leaked exploit kit targeting older iOS devices.  

Globally, markets are volatile due to Iranian officials rejecting negotiations, impacting oil prices and boosting China’s green energy stocks. TotalEnergies is shifting investments to Liquefied Natural Gas, and Berkshire Hathaway’s NICO acquired a $1.8 billion stake in Tokio Marine. The ACC is urging stricter sustainability reporting.

Geopolitically, President Trump is pursuing a potential deal with Iran, while a Colombian military plane crash resulted in 66 deaths. Australia and the EU finalized a trade deal, and Slovenia implemented fuel rationing. The US banned foreign consumer internet routers, and Israel is preparing for expanded operations in Lebanon amid ongoing conflict and settler attacks in the West Bank.

title: Overnight Market Brief - Bridging the Global Gap. Daily.
description:
While North America sleeps, the global economy keeps moving. Overnight Market Brief is your essential pre-market digest, designed for traders, serious investors, and professionals who need to hit the ground running.
Most North American investors miss 50% of the market story because it happens in Tokyo, Hong Kong, and London. We bridge that gap. Every morning at 8:00 AM ET, we deliver a concise, data-driven breakdown and full global picture in under 10 minutes, just in time for your morning commute.
latestSummary:
Wall Street opened firmly in risk-on mode on Tuesday, March 24, 2026, with the S&P 500 rising 1.14% and the Nasdaq 100 gaining 1.21%. This followed a prior session driven by broad buying, but was tempered by rising 10-Year Treasury yields (4.369%) and a stronger US Dollar Index (99.13), fueled by geopolitical concerns surrounding the Iran war. Crude oil prices also increased to 90.79.

Overnight, Asian markets exhibited resilience, with the Nikkei 225 up 1.43%, the Hang Seng surging 2.79%, and the Shanghai Composite climbing 1.78%, despite slowing growth in India and Japan. European markets faced pressure due to weaker-than-expected economic data, including declining UK retail sales and German business pessimism, linked to the Middle East conflict.

US futures were trading flat to slightly lower, reflecting investor caution following yesterday’s rally. Key catalysts for the upcoming session include the ongoing Iran war’s impact on oil prices, the potential for a global growth slowdown indicated by European economic data, and continued upward pressure on US Treasury yields and the dollar. The market is expected to trade range-bound until further developments occur.

title: Post-market Recap
description:
Did the market "rally into the close" or "fade the open"? The Post-Market Recap goes beyond the green and red arrows to analyze the structure of the trading day. This daily briefing dissects the inter-market correlations that drove the session.
Every afternoon, we cover:
Macro Causality: Connecting the dots between the 10-Year Yield, the Dollar Index, and Equities.
Tech & AI Pulse: A dedicated segment on the semiconductor ecosystem and Big Tech performance.
Market Breadth: Analyzing Volatility (VIX) and Sector Rotation to gauge genuine institutional sentiment.
Closing Catalysts: Identifying the specific news and data that triggered late-day reversals.

title: Geopolitical Updates
description: Beyond the headlines lies strategy. Geopolitical Updates is your daily guide to the evolving global order. Each episode provides a rapid scan of the day's top international stories, followed by a deep-dive analysis of the single most impactful event shifting the geopolitical landscape. From tension in the South China Sea to economic statecraft in Europe, we explain not just what happened today, but why it matters for tomorrow. Delivered daily at 7 PM ET.
latestSummary:
The ongoing conflict between Iran and the United States is escalating, shifting the rules of engagement to include targeting civilian infrastructure like energy and water systems. The U.S. issued an ultimatum to Iran regarding the Strait of Hormuz, while Iran threatens retaliation against U.S. energy infrastructure and Gulf neighbors. This escalation is impacting Asia with a burgeoning fuel crisis and driving oil prices past $100 a barrel.

In Eastern Europe, Russia launched a massive drone attack on Ukraine, the largest of its kind, straining Ukrainian defenses and humanitarian resources. Simultaneously, Australia and the E-U finalized a $12 billion trade agreement, aiming to bolster economies and foster strategic alignment. Israel announced plans for a buffer zone in southern Lebanon, restricting the return of displaced residents.

Economically, China is mitigating the fuel crisis with price controls, mirroring concerns across Asia. Slovenia became the first E-U nation to implement fuel rationing, limiting purchases to 50 liters per day. These events highlight a destabilized global landscape with potential long-term consequences including a redefined approach to warfare and increased risks to global trade routes. Monitoring the U.S.-Iran exchange and the international response to Israel’s actions are key priorities.
